// alu_decoder test vectors
// format: ALUOp(bin) funct3(bin) funct7(bin) op5(bin) ALUControl(bin)
// ALUControl: 00000 AND, 00001 OR, 00010 ADD, 00110 SUB, 00111 SLT, 01000 XOR, 01001 SLL,
//             01010 SRL, 01011 SRA, 01100 SLTU, 10000..10111 MUL..REMU
// ALUOp 00 -> ADD, 01 -> SUB whatever the funct fields
00 000 0000000 1 00010
00 111 1111111 0 00010
00 101 0100000 1 00010
01 000 0000000 1 00110
01 111 1111111 0 00110
01 101 0100000 1 00110
11 000 0000000 1 00010
11 111 1111111 0 00010
11 101 0100000 1 00010
// R-type (op5 = 1): base operations, SUB and SRA
10 000 0000000 1 00010
10 001 0000000 1 01001
10 010 0000000 1 00111
10 011 0000000 1 01100
10 100 0000000 1 01000
10 101 0000000 1 01010
10 110 0000000 1 00001
10 111 0000000 1 00000
10 000 0100000 1 00110
10 101 0100000 1 01011
// R-type M extension (op5 = 1, funct7 = 0000001)
10 000 0000001 1 10000
10 001 0000001 1 10001
10 010 0000001 1 10010
10 011 0000001 1 10011
10 100 0000001 1 10100
10 101 0000001 1 10101
10 110 0000001 1 10110
10 111 0000001 1 10111
// I-type (op5 = 0): funct7 is immediate bits and must not select SUB or M
// ADDI x1, x0, -5: instr[30] = 1 -> ADD, not SUB
10 000 1111111 0 00010
// ADDI x1, x0, 40: instr[31:25] = 0000001 -> ADD, not MUL
10 000 0000001 0 00010
// ADDI with funct7 = 0100000 -> ADD
10 000 0100000 0 00010
10 010 1111111 0 00111
10 011 0000001 0 01100
10 100 0100000 0 01000
10 110 0000001 0 00001
10 111 1111111 0 00000
10 010 0000001 0 00111
10 100 0000001 0 01000
// SLLI, SRLI, SRAI: funct7[5] selects SRA for SRAI too
10 001 0000000 0 01001
10 101 0000000 0 01010
10 101 0100000 0 01011
